policy_inputs: simulation estimated state proxy, not RGB-D images or measured real sensors
case_split_field: train refers to held-grasp-bank split; policy-unseen calibration cases are separated by source and seed
physical_scene: one fresh scene per training arm; one shared evaluation scene
physics_seed_unchanged_legacy_field: anchor argument 20261128 recorded by runner, not evidence of PhysX reseeding
rotation_schedule: episode-cyclic, not equal transition counts; actual exposure logged
pre_evaluation_provenance_limit: helper writes complete raw pre-evaluation trace but does not include the evaluation payload in training report; trace structure and recovered byte hashes are audited without claiming a missing report SHA
